Second Reality - unofficial Amiga AGA port
==========================================

This is an UNOFFICIAL fan port. It is not made, endorsed or supported by
Future Crew or by any of the original authors.

1. Second Reality (original demo, 1993, Future Crew)
   Source code and data were released by the original authors in 2013
   at https://github.com/mtuomi/SecondReality under the Unlicense
   (public domain dedication). The graphics, music (MUSIC0.S3M /
   MUSIC1.S3M) and other data in data/ are taken or converted from that
   release.

   Original credits (from the demo):
     Code      : Psi, Trug, Wildfire
     Graphics  : Marvel, Pixel, Skaven
     Music     : Purple Motion, Skaven
     Additional design : Abyss, Gore

2. SecondReality++ (https://github.com/XorJS/SecondRealityPlusPlus)
   Some final-release data and values (e.g. the end credits pictures and
   texts) were taken from this C++ port. It is released under the
   Unlicense.

3. This Amiga port (code under src/ in the project repository)
   Released under the Unlicense, the same as the original:

   means.

   of the public at large and to the detriment of our heirs and

   THE SOFTWARE IS PROVIDED "AS IS", WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY KIND,
   EXPRESS OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE WARRANTIES OF

   For more information, please refer to <http://unlicense.org/>

4. Third-party code
   m2.exe contains no third-party code. The start-up code and C runtime
   helpers (support/crt.c, support/muldi3.asm) were written for this port
   and are covered by item 3. The build uses GCC and the Amiga NDK headers
   only as tools; nothing from them is distributed apart from what the
   compiler generates.
